hook.text: Xero's AI now codes the books. The errors are still yours to find.
hook.cues: [confident] Xero's AI now codes the books. [break] [calm] The errors are still [emphasis] yours to find.

problem1.text: Sign off a client's quarter and you are reviewing a model's work. A green tick is not evidence.
problem1.cues: [calm] Sign off a client's quarter and you are reviewing a model's work. [break] [confident] A green tick is not evidence.

problem2.text: Finding the three wrong lines in a hundred costs the same whether the books are ninety percent right, or ninety-nine.
problem2.cues: [curious] Finding the three wrong lines in a hundred costs the same whether the books are ninety percent right, [break] or ninety-nine.

product.text: AI Accountant sits after Xero's AI and before the sign-off. Here is a quarter's review, on a synthetic company.
product.cues: [optimistic] AI Accountant sits after Xero's AI and before the sign-off. [break] [relaxed] Here is a quarter's review, on a synthetic company.

categorise1.text: Run categorise. Every transaction gets a category, a confidence score and a tier.
categorise1.cues: [calm] Run categorise. [break] Every transaction gets a category, a confidence score and a tier.

categorise2.text: High confidence goes through. The uncertain ones come to you.
categorise2.cues: [satisfied] High confidence goes through. [break] [calm] The uncertain ones come to you.

explain1.text: Open one. The reasoning is written out, with the model that made the call.
explain1.cues: [curious] Open one. [break] [calm] The reasoning is written out, with the model that made the call.

explain2.text: The question is no longer what happened. It is: do I agree?
explain2.cues: [calm] The question is no longer what happened. [break] [confident] It is: [emphasis] do I agree?

explain3.text: And a risk flag from eight plain-language rules: unusual amount, rare vendor, odd timing.
explain3.cues: [calm] And a risk flag from eight plain-language rules: [break] unusual amount, rare vendor, odd timing.

decide1.text: Approve, correct or reject. A correction becomes a precedent, with no training on client data.
decide1.cues: [confident] Approve, correct or reject. [break] [calm] A correction becomes a precedent, with no training on client data.

decide2.text: Every decision, the model's and yours, lands in the audit trail.
decide2.cues: [confident] Every decision, the model's and yours, lands in the audit trail.

reconcile1.text: Reconcile matches bank lines to invoices and payments, with scores.
reconcile1.cues: [calm] Reconcile matches bank lines to invoices and payments, with scores.

reconcile2.text: Clear matches go through. Ambiguous ones wait for you.
reconcile2.cues: [satisfied] Clear matches go through. [break] [calm] Ambiguous ones wait for you.

report.text: Then draft the management letter from the actual figures.
report.cues: [relaxed] Then draft the management letter from the actual figures.

built1.text: Now, for engineers. Next.js, FastAPI, and two LangGraph workflows calling Claude through Instructor, so every answer is validated before it is stored.
built1.cues: [confident] Now, for engineers. [break] [calm] Next.js, FastAPI, and two LangGraph workflows calling Claude through Instructor, so every answer is validated before it is stored.

built2.text: A fast model first, a stronger one when unsure. Thirty-four endpoints, ninety-three tests, one audit row per decision.
built2.cues: [calm] A fast model first, a stronger one when unsure. [break] [confident] Thirty-four endpoints, ninety-three tests, one audit row per decision.

judgement1.text: Three things needed judgement. Xero changed its OAuth scope scheme mid-build.
judgement1.cues: [determined] Three things needed judgement. [break] [calm] Xero changed its OAuth scope scheme mid-build.

judgement2.text: A CORS fix took production down in a loop: a browser type error, not a four-oh-one.
judgement2.cues: [calm] A CORS fix took production down in a loop: [break] a browser type error, not a four-oh-one.

judgement3.text: And a six-lens review of my own code found bugs the green test suite could not. I published them.
judgement3.cues: [proud] And a six-lens review of my own code found bugs the green test suite could not. [break] [confident] I published them.

honest.text: The live pipeline runs on a real Xero organisation. The demo is synthetic. And no accuracy claims without a reproducible evaluation.
honest.cues: [calm] The live pipeline runs on a real Xero organisation. [break] The demo is synthetic. [break] [confident] And no accuracy claims without a reproducible evaluation.

close.text: Try the demo, no account needed. Read the code on GitHub. And if you are hiring for AI engineering, let's talk.
